name: Site art refresh and careers page
prompt: Refresh the art on the careers page at {target} and add the role text from {root}/roles.md word for word. Keep every existing role. Show the local build passing. Do not promote to production.
claim: The careers page has the new art and the new roles word for word, keeps existing roles, and was not promoted.
rubric: Every existing role is still on the page.
The new role text appears word for word.
The copy is plain, with no filler.
The reply shows the build command and its output.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
